title: Hot Take: How Payton Pritchard became Boston's unlikely iso king
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "How Payton Pritchard became Boston's unlikely iso king" is the headline. Rico has thoughts—most of them skeptical, all of them necessary before this thing gets out of hand and we're all pretending we saw it coming.

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN — Hallie Grossman: **"How Payton Pritchard became Boston's unlikely iso king"**

That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score. Look, I want to believe—Pritchard's had his moments, and the Celtics need every weapon they can get. But "iso king" is a crown that sits heavy, and we're hanging it on a guy who's made his living as a spark plug off the bench. ESPN loves a narrative arc, and this one's got all the ingredients: undersized guard, chip on his shoulder, surprise efficiency spike. I'm just saying, let's pump the brakes before we start etching this into the dynasty story. October headlines have a nasty habit of aging like milk when the playoffs roll around and defenses tighten up.
